Instructions for Use
Device description: The Rhea Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Rhea Cochlear Implant is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 3.0T only
• Maximum spatial field gradient of 4000-gauss/cm or less
• Maximum gradient slew rate of 150 T/m/s per axis
• B1+RMS of 1 µT or less
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 1-W/kg
• RF excitation: circularly polarized (CP) only
• Scan regions: Head Only
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Rhea Cochlear Implant is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
